news.Title: 台股熱　外資賺飽飽！楊金龍：審慎評估颱風假交易　銀行沒有錢荒
news.Content:
台股近期在萬點高檔震盪拉鋸，市場高度關注颱風假股市交易機制、主權基金籌設進度以及整體市場資金動能。立法院財政委員會於今（28）日進行質詢，立委林德福針對多項熱點議題質詢中央銀行總裁楊金龍。

針對外界關注「股市不受颱風假影響維持正常交易」的建議，楊金龍表示，這牽涉投資人、銀行、證交所、期交所及櫃買中心等多方運作，範圍廣泛，應由主管機關金管會審慎評估與規劃，央行將在外匯方面全力配合。

在談到近期國際市場對人工智慧（AI）投資回報與泡沫化的疑慮時，楊金龍指出，市場雖有部分聲音，但若如外傳恐導致美股重挫四成、蒸發二十兆美元，「基本上這還是屬於比較極端一點的看法」。他並援引NVIDIA（輝達）執行長黃仁勳的說法表示，目前市場對資金的需求非常暢旺，關鍵在於是否有足夠的資金與之配合。

針對立委關切我國是否應設立主權基金，楊金龍坦言，以台灣目前的經濟實力來看確實具備這樣的能力，但規畫必須一步一步來、審慎進行，不需要隨外界起舞或受他人影響，應保有自己的定見與規畫程序。

至於外界以白銀價格波動作為判斷全球景氣放緩指標的看法，楊金龍則直言，央行在判斷整體經濟情況時，主要仍仰賴主要先進國家的經濟發展表現，「很少用白銀的價格來作為判斷整個全球經濟」。不過，對於立委建議央行在白銀價格相對較低時適時購入，以降低生肖套幣製作成本、減輕民眾負擔，楊金龍當場表示認同。

針對近期市場熱議的「銀行資金荒」與流動性覆蓋率（LCR）創新低議題，楊金龍嚴正表示，非常不贊同外界形容現在是「錢荒」的說法。他解釋，過去 LCR 達到130%其實有點偏高，目前大約120%是剛好的水準。之所以部分客戶在融資上感受到排擠效應，主因在於今年製造業與股市的資金需求都非常暢旺，導致邊際客戶受到排擠，「我想這是很自然的」。

news.Title: 焦點股：智原取得2奈米AI ASIC大型專案，股價跳空漲停
news.Content: 【財訊快報／研究員吳旻蓁】智原(3035)近期表示，委託設計（NRE）業務在先進製程成功搶下2奈米環繞閘極（GAA）製程雲端AI專案訂單，將搭配混合鍵合與3D封裝技術；而此項專案具指標性意義，包含設計製程、設計複雜度、NRE（委託設計）金額、高階封裝技術皆創公司新紀錄，將有助公司後續先進製程及高階封裝接單。公司第三季受惠量產業務優於預期，加上矽智財（IP）業績創下歷史新高，帶動單季營收創同期新高；公司也預期第四季營收可望維持高檔、持平第三季，全年營收可望維持成長。股價回檔於季線附近整理後，今在法說會挹注下，股價跳空漲停，日KD同步翻揚，目前季線已走平後向上，若後續補量，有利股價挑戰前波高點。

news.Title: Broadcom CEO says capital is ‘available’ after banks wavered
news.Content: Anyone who has co-signed a loan knows how it works. The borrower pays a rate that reflects the risk, and the co-signer is on the hook if payments stop. Broadcom Inc. (AVGO), one of the world's most valuable chipmakers, just took that seat for Anthropic. CEO Hock Tan spent nearly two months pushing banks to commit more than $40 billion to an Anthropic chip deal, The Wall Street Journal reported . With interest rates rising and AI ventures harder to fund, some lenders felt underpaid for the risk and weighed walking away. Tan held last-minute weekend talks with bank executives ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Broadcom's CEO, Hock Tan, secured over $40 billion in financing for Anthropic's chip deal by agreeing to higher interest rates, demonstrating capital availability for AI ventures.
• Broadcom is providing residual value support, effectively a significant guarantee, for approximately $43.5 billion of the $63 billion package, shielding lenders from potential Anthropic defaults.
• This deal increases Broadcom's exposure to a single customer, Anthropic, with its total debt backing potentially reaching $72.5 billion, raising concerns for rating agencies like Moody's.
• Despite the increased risk, Broadcom shares were up over 2% in premarket trading, though they remain down about 7% over the past 52 weeks, indicating some investor caution regarding AI spending.
news.Keywords: AI financing, credit guarantee, customer concentration, capital availability, residual value support

news.Title: 千金股重返49檔！股王信驊大漲近8% 股后川湖重返萬元 創意景碩5檔亮燈漲停
news.Content:
收盤更新

美股四大指數在AI買盤回流、國際油價下跌帶動下全面收紅，激勵台股今（28）日重返4萬7千點大關。千金俱樂部上演慶祝行情，股王信驊（5274）終場大漲7.99%至17,295元；股后川湖（2059）重返萬元寶座；第三高價股創意（3443）、精測（6510）、玉晶光（3406）、金像電（2368）、景碩（3189）5檔更強勢亮燈漲停。截至收盤，千金股共有49檔，25檔漲幅超過5%。

台股今日開高走高，盤中一度大漲964.23點、衝上47,060.46點，終場上漲939.35點、收在47,035.58點，重返4萬7大關。

權值股方面，台積電（2330）收漲25元至2,425元；聯發科（2454）強彈6.94%至4,235元，重返4千元大關；台達電（2308）也漲2.65%，成為推升指數的要角。

五大高價股齊步強攻，股王信驊（5274）終場收在17,295元，大漲1,280元或7.99%，持有一張帳面價值暴增128萬元。

股后川湖（2059）盤中一度漲4.89%，收盤上漲340元或3.47%至10,150元，重返萬元大關。

第三高價股創意（3443）表現同樣強勁，收在8,170元漲停價，且有近400張買單排隊等買；第四高價股健策（3653）盤中一度攻上漲停6,445元，隨後漲停打開，收盤漲幅收斂至8.79%、收在6,375元；第五高價股大立光（3008）則收在6,335元，同樣飆破半根漲停。

其餘千金股包括精測（6510）、玉晶光（3406）、金像電（2368）、景碩（3189）齊飆漲停；鴻勁（7769）、旺矽（6223）、台光電（2383）、世芯-KY（3661）、漢測（7856）、力旺（3529）、富世達（6805）、印能科技（7734）、群聯（8299）、高力（8996）、雙鴻（3324）、竑騰（7751）、台燿（6274）、昇達科（3491）、宜鼎（5289）、大量（3167）等收盤漲幅皆超過5%。

啟發投顧分析師郭憲政表示，今日千金股齊揚，主要受到美股強彈帶動，加上部分個股先前修正幅度較深，出現反彈行情。不過，聯發科、台達電、大立光及散熱指標股近期均經歷回檔，反映千金股走勢仍有分歧，尤其主力與法人資金可能轉向股價約數百元、經過回檔整理且具交易人氣的標的如國巨、南亞科、金居、穩懋及華新科等，因此投資人面對反彈應審慎，不宜急於追價。

至於千金股中的觀察重點，郭憲政點名玉晶光（3406），指出大盤先前自高檔回落，玉晶光卻持續突破，展現相對強勢。他認為，玉晶光除光學本業外，布局先進封裝的題材也值得關注，但今日盤中漲停、短線已走高，此時不建議追價。若投資人打算透過零股進行較長期布局，可等待股價回檔至5日均線1,176元附近，再評估介入時機。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】逼近4萬7！台股絕地反攻漲近900點 分析師陳石輝：樂看收紅
news.Content:
美股昨日收高，費城半導體指數、台積電-ADR大漲逾3%，台股今日早盤一度上漲至46,949點，漲點一度來到接近900點。運達投顧分析師陳石輝指出，今日早盤並未出現千點急拉，而是合理的漲幅開出並且沒有爆量，是健康格局，預估今日再拉下來回平盤機率低，已出現止跌跡象。

今日值班分析師：運達投顧分析師陳石輝

陳石輝指出，今日開盤以500-600點的漲點開出，其實相對於千點急漲來的健康，因為急漲上去可能出現短線客賣壓，反倒容易出現開高走低的盤勢。

陳石輝也強調，其實美股已經出現數日的止穩，今天在台股穩步上漲量能沒有大增的情況下，其實再拉下來到平盤的機會不大。

至於是否站上4萬7？陳石輝認為，單看今天站不站得上其實不是重點，因為後續遲早會站上，反倒是量能在收盤時應該維持在8000億元以下，預估成交量大概是在7500億元左右。

陳石輝也說明，目前已經出現止跌並看是否量縮，手中有持股者其實在這邊已經不用殺低，後續操作要將目光回歸第三季財報、10月營收等基本面來觀察。

news.Title: 智原今年IP業務衝新高，明年12奈米加入再向上
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-28 09:33:29 黃立安 發佈

ASIC設計服務暨矽智財(IP)商智原(3035)總經理王國雍表示，受惠晶圓代工夥伴產能利用率維持高檔，以及IP授權與權利金收入成長，今年第四季IP營收有望挑戰單季新高，全年亦將創歷史新高。展望明(2027)年，隨晶圓代工夥伴持續擴產及調漲價格，權利金收入可望再創高，加上Intel與聯電(2303)合作的12奈米IP平台啟動開發，逐步挹注相關收入，對明年IP成長充滿信心。

王國雍指出，智原過去投入約3至4年時間，完成14奈米IP平台建置，目前相關IP協定及技術架構已逐步完善，且平台具備可重複使用的特性，不僅能支援既有ASIC設計業務，也有助縮短後續製程節點的開發時程，提升研發效率及成本競爭力。

下一階段布局以12奈米IP作為重點發展方向。王國雍表示，由於12奈米與14奈米製程具有高度相似性，可運用既有14奈米平台累積的技術及IP資產，加速12奈米IP開發，並配合12奈米製程平台，擴大相關業務布局，預期隨12奈米IP逐步開發完成，相關收入將陸續增加。

王國雍進一步指出，智原在IP開發上採取雙軌策略，一方面針對具市場規模的製程節點建立完整IP平台，另一方面則依客戶需求及投資報酬率(ROI)，選擇性投入更先進製程的IP開發，包括配合ASIC設計客戶、晶圓代工夥伴及自有Edge AI專案需求，以確保研發資源投入能帶來實際商業效益。

展望明年，王國雍表示，隨晶圓代工夥伴持續擴充產能、產能利用率維持高檔，加上晶圓代工價格調漲，預期權利金收入將進一步提升並再創新高；同時，12奈米IP平台開始投入開發，相關IP收入可望逐步貢獻，對2027年整體IP營收持續成長持正向看法。

news.Title: 颱風假台股照樣開盤？沈伯洋提脫鉤 央行楊金龍：很多挑戰
news.Content:
薔琵颱風襲台期間，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋提出颱風假與股市休市脫鉤，中央銀行總裁楊金龍今（27）日在立法院財政委員會備詢，被問及對此建議的看法，他說，還有很多挑戰，若未來有相關規劃，央行將在外匯市場全力配合。

立委林德福關切股市颱風假是否比照國際市場維持交易，或改為居家線上交易？楊金龍說明，此舉影響層面廣泛，不僅涉及投資人、券商、期貨商、證交所與櫃買中心，還包含清算扣款銀行，若要全面改為居家交易，技術與作業流程仍面臨挑戰。

但楊金龍也強調，證券市場主管機關為金管會，應由金管會評估整體配套與可行性；若未來有相關規劃，央行將在外匯市場等全力配合。

行政院長卓榮泰日前也表示，面對颱風等天災，首要考量仍是「國人安全」，加上交易技術與數位科技是否成熟仍待評估，因此仍須進一步研議。

此外，針對央行最新報告指出AI投資熱潮支撐主要經濟體成長，卻也伴隨「投資回報不確定性及金融風險升高」，林德福詢問央行如何看待國際機構對AI資產修正的警示。

楊金龍回應，市場確實存在對AI產業投資回報與資產價格過熱的討論，但情況是否如極端報告預測般嚴峻仍有待觀察。央行將持續密切追蹤國際資金流向、科技股估值變化及相關金融風險指標，以維護國內金融市場穩定。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台積電連二漲！盤中漲30元至2430元 分析師：外資賣壓接近尾聲
news.Content:
台積電（2330）連二漲！今(28）日盤中一度漲30元，最高觸及2430元，分析師表示，「目前的賣壓已接近尾聲」，但即便快要結束，但現階段仍不建議盲目追價。

隨著油價回落、晶片股持續走揚，美股四大指數周二漲多跌少。其中，那斯達克盤中上漲 0.78%，費城半導體指數更強勢大漲2.5%；台股ADR則漲跌互見，鴻海ADR勁揚2%，台積電ADR盤中也一度上漲逼近2%。

台積電台北現股繼昨日收在2400元後，今日開高走高，盤中最高觸及2430元，上漲30元、漲幅達1.25%，連續上漲兩天。

摩爾投顧分析師何基鼎表示，外資賣壓已顯著減緩。先前市場主要擔憂中東局勢升溫會推升油價，但隨著美國聯準會（Fed）即將公布最新利率決策，市場已普遍預期本次不會升息，升息機率低於 10%。

此外，近期市場迎來利多消息，人工智慧（AI）巨擘 Anthropic 提交首次公開募股（IPO）申請，重燃市場對科技業的樂觀情緒，進一步帶動台積電與相關供應鏈大漲，儘管台積電開高後出現部分獲利了結賣壓，但何基鼎認為，「目前的賣壓已接近尾聲」，這不僅是指台積電本身的連日漲勢，更代表整體大盤的外資連續性賣壓。

何基鼎強調，短線上外資再大幅賣超台積電的空間相當有限，持續上攻的機率顯著提高。不過他也提醒，雖然賣壓即將結束，但現階段仍不建議盲目追價。

元大投顧報告則指出，外資雖然大力調節，但台積電股價顯然有多重支撐力道。加上外資目前對台積電的持股水位已降至 7 成以下，創下 2008 年以來的新低，因此只要賣壓告一段落，未來台積電仍是外資回補的首選目標。此外，供需缺口仍大的記憶體族群、因資安事件頻傳而受惠的軟體股，以及打底已久的強固型電腦，近期在逆勢中表現相對強勁，投資人近期可多加留意。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 三星、SK海力士領軍，KOSPI早盤飆逾5%，逼近六千點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國費半指數週二再漲3.60%、連續第三天收高，為亞洲半導體股送暖的同時，韓國股市週三(28日)早盤強勢上攻，依最新行情快訊，首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)漲幅擴大超過5%，報5,922.34點，向六千點整數關口探進。半導體雙雄領漲，三星電子(Samsung Electronics，韓股代碼005930)上漲逾7%，SK海力士(SK hynix，000660)勁揚逾5%。SK海力士最新公布的產業展望與股票回購計劃，成為市場關注焦點。公司預期記憶體供不應求將持續至2030年，已與14家主要客戶簽署長期供應合約，取得的合約量涵蓋2027年及2028年總產能逾50%，並預期明年投資規模將顯著增加。

股東回饋方面，SK海力士新增20兆韓元股票回購計劃，其中約10兆韓元將註銷，另約10兆韓元用於員工獎酬。公司同時預期，第四季HBM4出貨量與營收均將超越HBM3E，計劃年底前將M15X工廠產能提升至最大水準，擴大高附加價值記憶體供應。

韓股此波上漲延續前一日反彈走勢，KOSPI週二已大漲3.09%，收在5,638.34點，當天三星電子與SK海力士分別上漲4.23%及5.18%。

news.Title: 台股大復活！開盤暴漲近800點 台達電、聯發科強彈3％
news.Content:
美股周二收高，主因科技類股表現亮眼，台股今（28）日開盤上漲近800點，約來到46876.45點 。

台積電漲30元至2430元，台達電、聯發科強彈3%，聯電漲逾3%，記憶體及被動元件同步上揚。旺宏昨日公布第三季財報，單季稅後純益首度突破百億元，每股純益5.52元，同步刷新歷史新高紀錄，董事長吳敏求更表示，這是旺宏成立以來表現最佳的一季，激勵今日股價大漲近3%。

摩爾投顧林漢偉分析師表示，受惠美股科技股連續兩天走強，費半大漲3.6%，台指期夜盤強彈774點，電子權值股有望持續回穩。不過外資現貨仍然賣超，今天重點觀察台積電能否帶領指數突破上周四高點，以及記憶體、矽光子與AI伺服器的追價力道。

林漢偉分析師建議，投資人操作應維持「不追急漲、汰弱留強、突破再加碼」。若台積電站穩季線、櫃買突破5日線，加上外資賣壓減輕，反彈就有機會進一步延續。

台股昨日拉尾翻紅上漲54.8點，以46096.23點作收。外資賣超81.04億；自營商賣超123.99億元；投信買超236.45億元，三大法人合計買超31.42億元。

美股道瓊上漲15.99點或0.03%，收52,377.57點。S&P500上漲45.83點或0.60%，收7,722.60點。NASDAQ上漲308.43點或1.18%，收26,477.81點。費城半導體上漲399.04點或3.60%，收11,482.51點。

news.Title: 終究靠台灣人！CoWoS傳漲2成「台股夜盤飆774點」

美股科技股強勁反攻，費城半導體指數大漲3.6%、台積電ADR勁揚近3%，帶動台指期夜盤上演報復性大漲，指數狂飆774點！除了國際股市回穩帶動外，市場更傳出晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）因應AI晶片強烈需求，正醞釀新一輪調價，其中供不應求的CoWoS先進封裝報價傳出最高恐調漲20%；加上本土投信連續11天狂買近1,800億元的雄厚內資籌碼力挺，讓多頭軍心為之大振。對此，財經專家葉育碩直言，台股在經歷劇烈震盪後能迅速築底反彈，「終究還是得靠台積電跟台灣人的錢啊！」。

科技大廠加價搶產能2027年月，產能衝刺20萬片。（圖／民視新聞資料照）

CoWoS傳漲價最高2成！科技大廠加價搶產能2027年月　產能衝刺20萬片

在產業利多方面，受惠於全球生成式AI浪潮狂飆，下游客戶對先進封裝產能的渴求達到白熱化。業內人士透露，台積電及其封測夥伴正評估展開全新一波價格調整，目前市場極度短缺的CoWoS先進封裝報價，調漲幅度可能落在10%至20%之間，甚至傳出國際科技大廠抱持「只要能確保交期，加價也願意下單」的搶貨盛況；分析師推估，台積電2026年CoWoS月產能有望突破13萬片，2027年更將進一步挑戰20萬片大關，不僅坐擁龐大訂單動能，更凸顯台積電在供應鏈中的定價主導權。此外，國際科技巨頭資本支出亦持續暴增，Meta預期今年資本支出達1,350至1,450億美元並啟動千億美元融資，Anthropic亦深化與博通（Broadcom）高達1,612億美元的合作，皆替半導體供應鏈注入實質長線買氣。

投信連11買狂掃1800億，國人買ETF成最強底氣。（圖／民視新聞資料照）

投信連11買狂掃1800億！國人買ETF成最強底氣　夜盤狂飆助多頭喘息

除了基本面強悍撐腰，內資籌碼更是抗衡外資提款的最大功臣。檢視盤面數據，投信單日狂買超236.45億元，達成連續11個交易日大舉買超的紀錄，累計買超金額高達1,799.69億元。葉育碩分析，投信這股龐大的資金動能，最核心的活水源頭來自全台投資人踴躍申購台股ETF，散戶透過定期定額或大額申購將資金匯聚成龐大洪流，「咱們這群第四法人是真的很有錢」，已成為穩固台股防線的關鍵支柱。儘管本週市場仍聚焦Alphabet、微軟、亞馬遜等美股重量級財報，以及聯準會利率決策會議，但在台積電站穩神山本色與內資銀彈連環護航下，台指期夜盤強彈774點，不僅讓飽受震盪的多方投資人好好喘口氣，也再次印證本土實力才是台股最堅實的後盾。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》夜盤狂飆774點！今要噴了 11月衝5萬點還有「2大未爆彈」
news.Content:
小編今天（28）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。受到台積電ADR大漲3.03%提振，台指期夜盤狂拉774點，台積電期貨也重新站上季線。然而，外資於現貨端持續站在賣方，指數若要真正轉強，必須伴隨成交放大並越過上周四高點47332點壓力區。短線焦點應密切觀察記憶體、矽光子與 AI 伺服器等核心題材股，其續航力將主導多頭反彈力道。

【1】大盤11月行情 迎戰雙變數

台股11月行情迎來二大關鍵變數：本周「超級央行周」重磅登場，美、歐、日三大央行利率決策接力出爐，美國11月3日期中選舉也進入倒數，法人研判，三大央行本周均將按兵不動，惟聯準會偏鷹立場恐壓抑股市表現；期中選舉則以「參眾兩院分治」機率最高，有助降低政策不確定性，預期台股短線震盪難免，惟選後有望重啟攻勢，年底續拚50,000點大關。

【2】Anthropic示警依賴台積電風險

AI巨頭Anthropic美東時間10月26日正式申請公開上市，募資規模上看創紀錄的1,000億美元，資本市場高度關注，也牽動各大雲端服務供應商（CSP）和包括台積電在內的AI產業供應鏈。Anthropic在招股書上，直指台灣的地緣政治風險和台積電產能吃緊為其重大營運隱憂，凸顯台灣在當前AI產業發展的關鍵地位。

【3】股匯同步回神 台股拚返季線、台幣看Fed決策

台新投顧策略長黃文清分析，台股最恐慌、最壞時候已過，預期10月美國升息機率低，11月台股將入空窗期，有利多頭重展攻勢，台股站回季線後先看48,000點。至於11月28日九合一大選屬地方選舉，對股市影響有限，最重要是政策偏多不變，從國家隊積極逢低加碼可見端倪。

【4】暌違八年 頂新魏家重返台北101

台北101金融大樓27日公告申報股權轉讓，台灣伊藤忠持有17.27％台北101股權將賣回頂新魏家，由二董魏應交的成美創投接手，也將使頂新集團暌違八年後重回台北101，並再度成為單一最大股東，台北101明年的董事席次、經營權變化成為關注焦點。

【5】AI晶片大廠撒錢 綁定客戶

AI晶片大廠再度提供金援，協助客戶購買晶片。博通（Broadcom）攜手美國銀行（BofA）等4家華爾街巨頭，敲定630億美元融資協議，協助AI模型開發商Anthropic購買博通的晶片。此外，輝達（Nvidia）出資30億美元認購Meta新股，深化雙方AI合作。

news.Title: 【盤前焦點】美AI股勁揚台積電ADR漲　法人：台股拚收復季線

news.Title: 台積電CoWoS傳漲價、交期延長，先進封裝供需拉鋸加劇
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-28 08:29:06 數位內容中心 發佈

- 台積電10月27日傳出正醞釀調漲高階CoWoS封裝價格，漲幅上看20%；在AI晶片搶產能、設備交期拉長下，封裝交期也已延長至約8個月[1]。

- 當前關鍵限制仍在設備與材料交期、HBM記憶體供給吃緊，以及台積電是否正式且持續維持高幅度調價，短中期供需仍難快速回穩[1][2]。

- 接下來可留意主要客戶對漲價的接受度、封測廠包括力成的高階產品量產與良率，以及設備交期與上游載板擴產能否同步到位[3][4][5]。

10月27日，市場傳出台積電正醞釀調漲CoWoS等高階先進封裝價格，幅度上看兩成；同日，封測廠力成也宣布加速先進封裝轉型，表示FOPLP等高階產品將進入量產，並指出先進封裝已占集團營收逾三成，試圖以技術與大面積面板降低單位成本，緩解設備與交期壓力[1][3][6]。在此之下，市場供需與議價空間同步收斂：未滿足訂單持續累積，客戶在可保證交期的前提下減少砍價，設備交期最長已拉到約8個月，成為擴產與交貨的實際瓶頸[1]。

AI 與 HBM 升溫，推高先進封裝成本與報價

先進封裝需求升溫，主要來自AI GPU、伺服器CPU與客製化ASIC的擴張。尤其在HBM規格升級、供給持續吃緊之下，封裝與基板的複雜度、單位成本同步墊高，也讓封裝廠更有空間轉嫁成本[2][7][8]。市場研究與外資估算顯示，先進封裝價格自第二季起已上漲10%至30%不等，且LEAP、CoWoS等高階封裝比重持續提升，成為廠商毛利改善的主要動能[4][9]。終端方面，NVIDIA B200伺服器殘值仍維持高檔，也反映短期需求尚未明顯降溫，客戶對較高封裝成本的接受度因此提高[8]。

擴產啟動，但設備交期拉長讓缺口難補

設備與材料端已出現急單與擴產機會，相關設備廠正擴充清洗、沉積等產品線，搶攻先進封裝商機；不過，設備交期拉長、擴產到位也需要時間，短中期供需缺口仍難迅速填補[10][11]。在產能外溢方面，部分訂單已由一線封測廠轉向二線業者，華泰、超豐等接單增加，但分流效應仍待時間消化，競爭焦點也從價格轉向產能與技術能力[12]。市場同時警示，若多數新產能集中在2027至2028年開出，供需可能由短缺轉向過剩，屆時價格與稼動率都將面臨再調整壓力[5][13]。

營運面已可見漲價效應開始反映。日月光9月合併營收881.3億元、第三季合併營收2,441.61億元，單月與單季雙雙創高，外資也因此上修評價與目標價，認為封裝價格上揚與高階封裝比重提升，將持續推升毛利空間[9][4]。至於力成等封測廠，若量產後能穩住良率與交期承諾，也有機會在這波漲價循環中進一步放大獲利彈性[3]。

目前仍有兩項關鍵變數待觀察：其一，台積電是否會正式且長期維持CoWoS的大幅調價；其二，大型雲端與GPU客戶能否在更長約期內接受、或分攤這波成本上升。接下來的走向，仍將取決於台積電與主要客戶的正式報價策略、封測廠量產與良率進展，以及設備交期能否隨擴產逐步回穩[1][3][6]。

news.Title: SK Hynix Profit Jumps Seven-Fold to Soothe Doubts Over AI Rush
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- SK Hynix Inc. posted a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in quarterly profit and unveiled an additional shareholder return program for 2026 worth 100 trillion won ($75 billion), underscoring relentless demand for AI hardware.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Finland and Norway Hold 'Frank' Call With Putin on Ukraine

Lula Wins Record Fourth Term in Surprise Brazil Comeback

US to Take In Bolsonaro After He Loses Election and Flees Brazil

Anthropic Files for IPO in Global Race to Raise Cash for AI

The world's second-biggest memory chipmaker reported operating profit of 83.3 trillion won in the September quarter, beating analysts' average projection for 77.5 trillion won. Revenue climbed to 104.6 trillion won, against the average estimate of 99 trillion won.

The result bolsters hopes for sustained profit from the surge in demand for memory from artificial intelligence developers building data centers. That's come in for increasing scrutiny in recent weeks with challenges in financing and setting up ambitious infrastructure projects.

SK Hynix has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI frenzy, supplying high-bandwidth memory to Nvidia Corp. while capitalizing on soaring prices of conventional memory chips. Its operating margins remain at historically elevated levels, reflecting tight supply. On Wednesday, the company said it expects memory supply shortages to last through 2030.

The additional shareholder payouts could provide another catalyst for the stock price after the chipmaker abandoned a potential US listing of its Solidigm unit amid shareholder opposition and regulatory scrutiny. Solidigm is in talks with the US Commerce Department to invest $45 billion in a new chip plant on American soil, Bloomberg News reported.

Memory now constitutes roughly a third of all expenses related to AI data centers, according to research by Macquarie, and SK Hynix plays a key role in that business with its close collaboration with Nvidia. That share of overall computing-hardware spending is expected to rise in the coming years as HBM prices are set to more than double in 2027, Macquarie said.

SK Hynix has prioritized long-term contracts with customers including Nvidia. Like competitors Samsung Electronics Co. and Micron Technology Inc., it's shifted production in recent years toward HBM, tightening supply of conventional memory.

"While HBM is seeing a price appreciation, the sharp surge in earnings is attributed to the rapid price hikes in conventional DRAM and NAND," said MS Hwang, director at Counterpoint Research. "Quarterly earnings have not yet reached their peak and the upward trajectory will likely sustain at least through 2027."

news.Title: 主動ETF逼近兆元！83%仍集中台股　「這兩類」成新秀
news.Content:
全球ETF市場持續高速狂奔，美國資產規模在今年9月底正式突破16.3兆美元，相較2024年的7兆美元水準暴增超過130%。不僅海外市場熱鬧滾滾，台灣國內的ETF版圖也迎來結構性轉變。

根據投信投顧公會與摩根資產管理最新統計，截至今年9月底，台灣主動式ETF整體規模已逼近新台幣兆元大關、達到9,947億元。雖然其中有高達8,268億元（占比約83%）仍高度集中於台股型產品，但跨國配置的資金動能正悄悄崛起，為台灣投資市場吹響邁向全球多點開花的全新號角。

台灣主動式ETF悄悄轉向　跨國債券與海外股票增溫

進一步觀察今年下半年以來的變化，台灣主動式ETF整體規模在短短一季內從6月底的9,615億元增至9,947億元，成長約3.5%。雖然台股型仍以8,268億元穩居主導地位（季增3.27%），但海外股票型規模也維持在1,432億元的高檔。

更受矚目的是跨國債券型產品，規模從6月底的178億元激增至248億元，單季成長率高達39.33%。這顯示出國內投資人在主動式ETF的選擇上，已逐漸跨出舒適圈，將目光延伸至海外股票與固定收益市場，尋求更具廣度的資產配置。

全球資金流向大洗牌　已開發市場成新寵

把視野拉回國際，全球ETF的資金流向也透露出「分散配置」的強烈訊號。儘管美國市場仍是資金吸金核心，今年9月單月吸引339億美元淨流入，但歐洲、日本等已開發市場受青睞的程度正急速升溫。數據顯示，已開發市場的單月淨流入金額從6月的176億美元一路攀升，至9月已達到224億美元，增幅高達27%；相較之下，新興市場9月僅獲13億美元淨流入，動能出現明顯退燒跡象。

摩根資產管理分析，ETF市場的快速成長不單單只是產品數量增加，更反映出投資人運用ETF的思維正在全面進化。過去投資人多半著重於追蹤大盤的被動型商品，如今則積極擁抱主動式ETF等多元策略，透過全球化佈局來滿足資產成長與現金流收益的雙重需求。

隨著美國市場持續引領風騷，加上歐洲與日本等成熟市場的重要性日漸提升，投資人的資產配置版圖正加速從單一走向全球，迎來多點開花的全新時代。

news.Title: 台股震盪900點！外資瘋狂提款　杜金龍點名「這幾檔」逢低布局
news.Content:
台北股市27日上演驚心動魄的震盪行情，盤中高低洗盤高達908.78點，終場驚險甩尾收紅，小漲54.8點收在46096.23點。面對外資短線瘋狂提款達一兆元的恐慌賣壓， 資深分析師杜金龍 精準指點台股這幾檔低檔撿寶的黃金時機，強調大盤波浪理論的主升段架構依然穩固，隨著不確定因素沉澱，急跌拉回反倒砸出了難得一見的超值買點。

【外資狂賣一兆震撼洗盤！杜金龍揭波浪理論主升段目標】

受到台幣貶值影響，外資短線加速抽離資金，光是10月份以來，外資在集中市場瘋狂提款，加上自營商同步調節，三大法人10月份在台股的累計賣超金額在月底正式「破兆」，期貨空單更一度突破8萬口，導致台股近期洗盤動輒高達900多點。

不過政府基金展現護盤決心連買12天，投信也同步大舉進駐。杜金龍分析，目前市場僅是受到政治選情與外資提款的短期壓抑， 台股依舊紮實位於波浪理論的「主升段」 。待11月初政治不確定因素沉澱後，將迎來 第4季至明年春節與元宵的傳統上漲行情。 歷年春節與元宵行情平均有1,500至1,800點的漲幅空間，杜金龍進一步預估 ，明年2月至5月指數有機會上看53,000至60,000點 ，長線在2028年更將朝80,000點終極目標邁進。

【台積電與聯發科殺出買點！杜金龍親自下場分批撿寶】

在大盤高位回檔之際，權值龍頭股展現極佳的承接價值。杜金龍透露近期已在台積電（2330）2,420元與2,390元掛單分批低接，觀察到 台積電在2,400元以下有強烈政府基金護盤支撐 ，且外資已將其明後年EPS上調至210幾元，目標價甚至喊上5,000元。另一方面，IC設計龍頭 聯發科（2454） 跌破4,000元關卡，較高點修正逾兩成已進入超跌區，具備優異投資性價比；電源管理龍頭 台達電（2308） 從高點2,500元大幅拉回至1,400至1,500元區間，修正幅度近四成，同樣是分批建立基本部位的絕佳時機。

【記憶體與CCL族群抗跌飆爆！南亞科目標價直指千金】

除了權值三雄外，中小型族群與集團股同樣孕育豐厚反彈動能。記憶體大廠南亞科（2408）獲法人大幅升評，預估明年營收年增率高達66.8%，毛利率上看84.5%，全年EPS估賺進128.01元，基本面強悍且長線具衝刺千金股實力；同族群的華邦電（2344）與旺宏（2337）亦可安心持股等待估值修復。銅箔基板（CCL）族群中，台燿（6274）受傳言影響遭遇殺盤，但短線以股價活潑的聯茂（6213）最具衝勁，長線龍頭首推台光電（2383）。此外，台塑集團旗下的南亞（1303）受惠於資產重估與每股淨值暴增優勢，股價大幅回檔時皆是值得分批承接的優質標的。

news.Title: 台股大跌別慌！今年EPS估增67%　它搶攻下波中小飆股
news.Content: 根據最新預測，2026年及2027台股EPS成長率預估分別高達67.2%與29.7%，台股後市展望依然偏樂觀，台股上半年財報及法說普遍優於預期，市場對2026及2027年EPS成長持續上修，短線大跌皆是布局良機；惟2027年EPS成長相對2026年相對降速，這意味明年指數報酬可能不會像今年一樣。 投資風格將由Beta(與市場連動)轉向Alpha（超額報酬），將是中小利基股表現的天下，國內首檔台股中小主動式ETF「台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金（00416A）」已於10/14獲准成立，掌握長線大行情。 台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金（00416A）經理人沈建宏表示，在中東情勢又趨緊張下，布蘭特原油期貨近期一度站上每桶100美元，最新公布的美國9月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率由8月3.4%升至3.7%，高於市場預期3.6%，讓市場對聯準會（Fed）10月升息的預期大幅提升，衝擊美股四大指數大幅回檔，也拖累台股跌破4萬7000點關卡。 由於前波台股波段反彈超過4000點，融資餘額逼近前波高點又回到6300億元以上，漲多後籌碼須沉澱，追價意願可能轉弱，因此預期10~11月將維持震盪格局，個股表現為主，則具利基題材的中小股相對有表現空間。 沈建宏指出，企業獲利成長往往為股市上漲的風向球，而獲利成長性較高的企業，也會享有較高的本益比評價，具AI供應鏈優勢的台灣中小型股，獲利成長性強勁，過去三年股價爆發力遠遠超越大盤及權值股，近三年台股漲幅前30名，皆為股本80億以下的股票，如奇鋐、台光電、旺矽、台燿等。就後市表現分析，AI齊漲格局已過，後續各產業會出現分化，且基期已墊高，成長性不如發展初期，則更需要經理人精選持股，因此，投資人布局台股中小主動式ETF可提高勝率。

news.Title: Amid the Anthropic IPO excitement, don't forget about earnings season
news.Content:
We are only two days into the week, and it already feels like it should be the weekend.

In the past two days, Meta ( META ) said it will raise $95 billion to support its AI build-out through stock offerings, and Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ) dropped a 407-page IPO prospectus that I know you haven't read in its entirety. (Wall Street hasn't either, so don't lose sleep over it.)

Lost in that activity is that earnings season continues in full swing, with results from Coca-Cola ( KO ), Hilton ( HLT ), UPS ( UPS ), Whirlpool ( WHR ), and others today.

While investors are jacked up about AI and some stability returning to the tech trade, don't lose sight of earnings season: After all, it's earnings and earnings expectations that power stocks, not Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei (although his comments have moved markets in the past).

So here are a few quick takes on a couple of earnings reports I chewed through this morning:

The consumer travel read

I don't have any problems with this Hilton quarter, even though the stock is getting hit on a slight revenue miss. The important revenue per available room metric grew 5.8%, the company remains an aggressive buyer of its stock, and it approved the development of 30,500 rooms in the quarter.

The report fits nicely with the Delta ( DAL ) report we got last week, in that higher fuel prices don't appear to be slowing leisure or business travelers.

I think it also fits nicely with the numbers out of UPS today, with US sales up 4.5% and its full-year guidance hike.

Big food battles

Coca-Cola's latest guidance lift reinforces the view that the company continues to take massive market share away from rival PepsiCo ( PEP ). Coke Zero sales surged 16%.

Not a good day for the team at PepsiCo up in Purchase, N.Y.

A weak housing market is hurting appliance sales

I continue to be absolutely shocked by what's happening at Whirlpool ( WHR ). Another supersoft quarter, with an adjusted loss of $0.21 per share. Costs are up, and the business is being hurt by a near-frozen US housing market.

You need nerves of steel to buy Whirlpool shares here — the stock is down more than 63% this year. If you do, the thesis has to be that the iconic company is acquired at some point in the next 12 months.

news.Title: Broadcom Drops 6% in a Month: Buy, Sell or Hold the AVGO Stock?
news.Content:
Broadcom AVGO shares have dropped 5.8% over the past month, underperforming the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector's drop of 5.1%. The company's shares have suffered from margin pressure from the rising AI mix, supply constraints, a concentrated AI clientele and weak non-AI business.

AVGO shares have also underperformed NVIDIA NVDA, Advanced Micro Devices AMD and Skyworks SWKS over the same period. Shares of NVIDIA have dropped 5.6%, while AMD and Skyworks have declined 12.6% and 4.8%, respectively. So, what should investors do with the AVGO stock post the dip? Let us find out.

AVGO Stock's Price Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

AVGO's Prospects Suffer From Multiple Challenges

Broadcom's rapidly expanding custom accelerator business is weighing on consolidated gross margins because XPUs carry an increasing proportion of expensive memory content. In the third quarter of 2026, non-GAAP gross margin declined 210 basis points sequentially to 75%. AVGO expects gross margin to decline further to approximately 73% in the fourth quarter compared with 78% in the year-ago period. Continued growth in lower-margin AI hardware relative to software could limit profitability expansion, although operating leverage should provide some offset.

AVGO faces limitations involving advanced semiconductor wafers, high-bandwidth memory, substrates and optical components. The company's custom AI accelerator business currently depends on six major customers, exposing AVGO to changes in hyperscaler capital spending and product strategies. Competition from NVIDIA, AMD, MediaTek and customers' internal semiconductor development teams could intensify over time. Any loss of design wins, customer insourcing or moderation in AI infrastructure investments could affect revenue growth and long-term earnings visibility.

Moreover, Broadcom's non-AI semiconductor business continues to experience relatively modest growth compared with its AI portfolio. In the third quarter of 2026, non-AI revenues increased only 5% year over year to $4.2 billion and remained flat sequentially. While broadband and server storage demand improved, weakness in wireless partially offset these gains. Continued softness across traditional semiconductor end markets could constrain revenue diversification. Broader concerns surrounding the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending have also weighed on semiconductor stocks, including Broadcom.

Can AVGO's Strong AI Growth Boost Competitive Prowess?

Broadcom expects AI semiconductor revenues to reach approximately $58 billion in fiscal 2026, followed by $115 billion in fiscal 2027 and $230 billion in fiscal 2028. These projections reflect increasing deployments of custom accelerators and AI networking equipment by leading frontier-model developers.

Broadcom's long-term agreement with Google to develop and supply future generations of TPUs and networking products through 2031 strengthens revenue visibility. Anthropic is expected to deploy an additional 5 gigawatts of TPU capacity in 2027 and 10 incremental gigawatts in 2028. OpenAI is targeting more than 5 gigawatts of custom accelerator deployments in 2028, while Meta is expected to deploy approximately 3 gigawatts through 2028. These customer roadmaps offer substantial multiyear growth opportunities.

Broadcom's expertise in advanced packaging, high-speed SerDes, chip-to-chip interconnects and high-bandwidth memory integration provides a competitive advantage. The company's ability to co-develop accelerators optimized for customers' specific AI workloads could support additional design wins. Increasing semiconductor complexity and the transition toward multi-die architectures may further strengthen demand for Broadcom's engineering capabilities.

Growing enterprise requirements for data sovereignty, cybersecurity and cost-effective AI infrastructure could strengthen adoption of VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware Private AI Cloud. These platforms enable organizations to operate AI workloads alongside existing enterprise applications. Rising subscription adoption and recurring revenues could improve software revenue visibility and support Broadcom's long-term profitability.

However, Broadcom's projected growth relies heavily on sustained capital expenditures by a limited number of hyperscalers and AI model developers. Higher HBM content, increasingly complex packaging and growing dependence on custom accelerators could continue pressuring gross margins. Although Broadcom expects operating leverage to offset some dilution, rising manufacturing costs or unfavorable semiconductor pricing could constrain long-term margin expansion. The company is facing stiff competition, which is a concern for investors.

Story Continues

AVGO's FY26 Earnings Estimate Revision Shows Steady Trend

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for fiscal 2026 earnings is pegged at $11.79 per share, unchanged over the past 30 days, indicating 72.87% growth from the fiscal 2025 reported figure.

Broadcom Inc. Price and Consensus

Broadcom Inc. price-consensus-chart | Broadcom Inc. Quote

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings is pegged at $3.82 per share, unchanged over the past 30 days, indicating 95.9% growth from the figure reported in the year-ago quarter.

AVGO Stock: Buy, Sell or Hold?

Broadcom shares are trading at a premium, as suggested by the Value Score of F.

In terms of the forward 12-month price/sales (P/S), AVGO is trading at 9.04X, higher than the broader sector's 5.49X. Broadcom is also trading at a premium compared with peers, NVIDIA and Skyworks, shares of which are currently trading at 9.96X and 2.76X, respectively.

AVGO Shares Are Overvalued

Broadcom's expanding AI portfolio is expected to drive top-line growth. However, elevated AI expectations, a decline in gross margin expansion and customer concentration do not justify AVGO's current valuation.

Broadcom currently has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), suggesting investors should wait for a more favorable point to start accumulating the stock. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

news.Title: Nvidia Just Announced Plans to Pour Billions Into Meta's Muse
news.Content:
When Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) released its quarterly report last week, it contained more than the usual financial information. The social media and artificial intelligence (AI) purveyor announced plans to create a new class of stock -- Class C shares. This non-voting stock, which is poised to begin trading early next year, will be used primarily to raise capital for its soaring AI expenses, employee compensation, and to fund potential acquisitions. Meta plans to effect a 2-for-1 stock split on Jan. 19, 2027 -- in the form of a stock dividend -- issuing one share of Class C stock to shareholders of record for each share of Class A or Class B common stock they own.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Perhaps as importantly, Meta announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to backstop its heavy investments in AI -- and the move is attracting backing from some of the biggest names in technology. Chief among them is Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), arguably the architect of the AI revolution. Just this morning, the semiconductor specialist announced plans to pour billions of dollars into Meta to fund its AI ambitions.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

You can't spell AI without Nvidia

In a separate press release that dropped on Monday, Nvidia and Meta announced plans to expand their collaboration on the Muse family of AI models, citing the growing popularity and demand for AI agents. Indeed, Meta's Muse models and AI agents, powered by Nvidia processors, have "delivered frontier-level benchmark performance and surging consumer downloads since launch," according to the release.

The pair plan to deepen their collaboration, "by partnering on optimizations across workflows to maximize performance and improve total cost of ownership." Nvidia and Meta are also exploring other opportunities, including the use of Nvidia's OpenShell and Sentry, designed to ensure the safe deployment and monitoring of AI agent behavior.

Meta also plans to increase its deployment of Nvidia's Vera Rubin graphics processing units (GPUs), Vera CPUs, and Spectrum-X Ethernet to boost the performance of its AI agents,

Meta is already one of Nvidia's biggest customers. The pair expanded their partnership earlier this year, announcing a multi-year deal in which Meta would deploy "millions" of Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin chips, as well as the company's Grace and Vera CPUs.

Story Continues

Show me the money

Meta's fundraising efforts will be spread out over the coming months. First, the company will raise $35 billion through an underwritten public offering, attracting foundational investors such as Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices , and Broadcom . The trio of AI chipmakers have expressed interest in buying up to $5 billion in Meta's Class A shares, with Nvidia contributing $3 billion. Meta plans to raise another $60 billion through the sale of Class C shares beginning early next year.

The fundraising binge comes at a critical time for the tech giant. Meta recently confirmed that it is on track to have 2026 capital expenditures in the range of $135 billion to $145 billion, roughly double the $72.2 billion the company spent last year.

Concerns about the company's legal challenges and heavy spending on AI have weighed on Meta, which has shed 16% over the past year. However, at 21 times earnings, the stock has much of the downside potential priced in.

For its part, Nvidia continues to post year-over-year revenue and profit growth of more than 100%, yet is selling for less than 28 times earnings.

Despite the risk of a potential slowdown in AI-related spending, both of these industry titans are attractively priced.

news.Title: Travelzoo Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Travelzoo? Here are five stocks we like better.

Revenue grew 3% year over year to $22.9 million , but Travelzoo posted a $2.6 million quarterly loss as it accelerated marketing spending to expand its paid Club Member base.

Club Members increased 65% year over year , while acquisition costs fell to $54 from $62 in the prior quarter. Management expects membership investments to support recurring revenue and potentially add $1.20 to 2027 earnings per share.

Travelzoo expects revenue growth in the fourth quarter and beyond as deferred membership revenue is recognized; the company also plans to launch its exclusive META experiences in Q4 2026 and improve offer personalization using artificial intelligence.

3 Small-Cap Stocks Ready to Deliver Significant Growth

Travelzoo (NASDAQ:TZOO) reported third-quarter revenue growth but posted a loss as it increased spending to expand its paid Club Member base and build recurring membership-fee revenue.

Consolidated revenue rose 3% year over year to $22.9 million, or $23 million in constant currencies, Financial Controller for North America Jeff Hoffman said on the company's third-quarter 2026 earnings call. The company reported a $2.6 million loss for the quarter, compared with operating profit of $0.5 million a year earlier. Non-GAAP operating loss was $2.1 million, versus non-GAAP operating profit of $1.1 million in the prior-year period.

→ Can Planet Fitness Get Its Growth Back in Shape?

Management attributed the loss primarily to accelerated marketing investment aimed at adding paid Club Members. The company said Club Members increased 65% from a year earlier, representing its largest quarterly addition of members to date.

Membership Investment Pressures Near-Term Results

Travelzoo is seeking to shift more of its revenue mix toward recurring membership fees. Hoffman said subscription revenue is recognized ratably over the membership period, while member-acquisition costs are immediately expensed as marketing costs. That accounting treatment is weighing on current-period earnings as the company adds members.

→ Consumer Staples Are Up 12% This Year—These 3 Beverage Stocks Are Leading the Way

The company said it expects these investments to support improved profitability as deferred and recurring revenue grows. Hoffman said Travelzoo estimates a positive impact on 2027 earnings per share of $1.20 from its membership-growth efforts, while cautioning that reported net income may fluctuate in the near term.

Average acquisition cost for a Club Member declined to $54 in the third quarter from $62 in the second quarter, despite the company increasing its member-acquisition activity. Hoffman said a U.S. member pays a $50 annual fee at the beginning of the membership period and generated an average of $15 in transaction revenue within 90 days, before potential future renewal, transaction and advertising revenue.

Story Continues

→ Newmont's Record Quarter Shows Why Gold's Floor Is the Real Story

Chair, Chief Membership Officer and General Counsel Christina Ciocca said the lower acquisition cost reflected the availability of attractive offers used across channels including Facebook. The company was able to run larger volumes of offers and scale spending when consumer interest was strong, she said.

During the question-and-answer session, Global CEO Holger Bartel said that roughly half of member growth typically comes from converting legacy members and half from acquiring new members. In the third quarter, new members represented slightly more than half of additions, he said.

Deferred Revenue Timing and Segment Trends

Bartel addressed analyst questions regarding the relationship between record member additions and deferred revenue. He said many new customers initially join through a 30-day trial, priced at $1 in the U.S. and £1 in the U.K. Full membership revenue and related deferred revenue are recorded only after customers convert following the trial period.

"The more members we add, the higher and more fast deferred revenue will grow," Bartel said. He said Travelzoo had approximately $13 million in deferred revenue on its balance sheet and that the company's projected membership revenue of more than $30 million in 2027 incorporates existing members, expected renewals and new member additions.

Both the North America and Europe segments increased revenue during the quarter, according to Hoffman. Jack's Flight Club reported a revenue decline, which management attributed to a decrease in deferred revenue resulting from fewer members acquired during the first and second quarters.

Travelzoo ended Sept. 30 with $8.8 million in consolidated cash equivalents and restricted cash, up $1.2 million from the second quarter. The company repurchased 256,898 shares of common stock during the quarter. Bartel also said accounts receivable had returned to normal levels after being exceptionally high in the second quarter for specific reasons.

Offers, Retention and Travel Demand

Bartel said exclusive travel offers remain the principal factor driving member retention and renewals. Travelzoo highlighted offers ranging from U.K. inn stays to cruises and luxury travel experiences, as well as benefits such as airport-lounge access during flight delays and the Travel Enthusiast Hotline launched with Allianz in the first quarter.

Management said Travelzoo members are generally affluent and open to travel ideas and new destinations. Bartel said the company's customer base is positioned toward the higher-income end of the market, where consumers have continued to spend on travel.

Addressing questions about unrest and protests in Europe, Bartel said such events have historically affected travel behavior only in the short term. He added that hotels and travel suppliers facing lower occupancy or seasonal demand may turn to Travelzoo for help promoting offers, while members' willingness to consider different destinations gives the business flexibility.

META Launch and Outlook

Ciocca said the first Travelzoo META experiences are expected to become available in the fourth quarter of 2026. Access will be an exclusive benefit of Travelzoo Club Membership, although Bartel said the product may also be purchased separately. Management plans to market META as it launches and said it has assessed comparable products and services while developing the offering.

Bartel also said the company is integrating artificial intelligence into its business, including to help members find offers and improve customization. He maintained that Travelzoo's negotiated offers differ from broadly available online travel agency listings because they are exclusive to the company.

For the fourth quarter, Travelzoo expects year-over-year revenue growth. The company also expects growth in subsequent quarters as membership-fee revenue is recognized over 12 months, more members join and legacy members convert to Club Members. Management said it expects profitability to improve over time as recurring membership fees increase.

About Travelzoo (NASDAQ:TZOO)

Travelzoo (NASDAQ: TZOO) is an internet media company that publishes travel and entertainment offers for consumers. Its platform features deals on hotels, vacations, cruises, flights, restaurants, spas, events and other leisure activities, connecting participating businesses with an audience of members and website visitors.

The company's products and services include its travel and local-deals publications, destination and deal guides, and online tools that help users discover and compare travel opportunities.

news.Title: Coinbase Now Offers Fixed-Rate Bitcoin-Backed Loans. Here's What Crypto Investors Need to Know.
news.Content:
Coinbase (NASDAQ: COIN), one of the most popular crypto exchanges, has offered on-chain Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC)-backed loans since January 2025. These loans allow you to borrow USDC against your Bitcoin, but until recently, only variable-rate loans were available.

On Sept. 22, Coinbase announced fixed-rate Bitcoin-backed loans through Morpho Midnight. While this could be a useful option in certain situations, investors should understand the terms first.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

How Coinbase's fixed-rate Bitcoin-backed loans work

Coinbase offers loans through its Coinbase Borrow service. Morpho Midnight is a lending protocol that operates on Base, an Ethereum Layer-2 blockchain. When you borrow this way, your Bitcoin is converted to Coinbase Wrapped BTC and locked in a smart contract on Base.

These are short-term loans, with payment due in full by maturity. Loans mature on either the last Friday of the current month or the next month, so you can't use them for long-term financing. If you don't repay the loan before maturity, the lender has a claim on your collateral. You can repay your loan early if you want, but you owe the same amount of interest.

Coinbase hasn't shared available interest rates. A spokesperson for the crypto company disclosed that rates are determined by supply and demand, with borrowers and lenders posting offers on an on-chain order book.

Fixed vs. variable loans on Coinbase

The new fixed-rate loans are another borrowing option on Coinbase, which already offered variable-rate loans. Variable-rate loans allow users to borrow up to $5 million in USDC against their Bitcoin. This type of loan has no set term length, minimum payment requirements, or due dates, making it a much more flexible borrowing option, but you risk your loan rate increasing.

Coinbase's variable-rate loans have an initial loan-to-value (LTV) limit of 75%. If you have $100,000 in Bitcoin, you could borrow up to $75,000. The liquidation threshold is an LTV of 86%. Given Bitcoin's often significant price fluctuations, LTV can change quickly.

If you take out a loan for the full 75% limit against your collateral, Bitcoin only needs to drop about 13% to hit that 86% liquidation threshold. Coinbase hasn't clarified whether fixed-rate loans are subject to the same LTV limit and liquidation threshold.

Story Continues

Bitcoin-backed loans are useful, but risky

Being able to borrow against your Bitcoin is convenient. You can get a loan while holding your crypto, similar to how investors with margin accounts can borrow against their stock holdings.

However, the short terms on Coinbase's fixed-rate loans limit what you can do with them. They're really only useful in situations where you need some quick cash, like an emergency expense, and you know you'll be able to repay the loan in full within one to two months. The volatility of the crypto market also makes Bitcoin-backed loans much riskier than loans backed by other types of collateral.

If you borrow against your crypto, keep your LTV ratio low to protect against a sudden margin call.

news.Title: Anthropic’s IPO Filing Revealed a Loss of $80.7 Billion in 6 Months. But You Might Be Surprised How Much It's Really Making.
news.Content:
Anthropic just released its public IPO filing, but an eye-popping figure leaked about a week earlier. The massive company that develops the Claude AI models reported a net loss of $80.7 billion for the first six months of 2026. That is almost five times the $16.3 billion of revenue it reported for the same period.

At first glance, this might look like a major red flag for investors. But if you look a little deeper into the filing, you'll see that Anthropic earned an adjusted profit of $2.7 billion for the first half. But how can this be? Here's what investors need to know about the gap between the company's reported loss and how much money it is actually making.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Where Anthropic's $80.7 billion "loss" came from

Here's how the math works. I mentioned earlier that Anthropic reported $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026. The company also spent about $17 billion running the business, resulting in an operating loss of about $700 million ($693 million, to be exact). That's about 4% of revenue and is a far more reasonable loss than the headline number implies, especially for a rapidly growing company like Anthropic.

In addition, Anthropic holds about $131.7 billion of cash and short-term investments on its balance sheet, and the company generated $1.1 billion of interest income. So, this would actually put the profitability slightly in the black.

So, where did the $80.7 billion loss come from? Mostly, there was a $72.4 billion accounting charge related to changes in the fair value of convertible notes. In a nutshell, convertible notes are a form of debt that holders can elect to convert into stock at a predetermined conversion price. So, because Anthropic's valuation increased sharply this year, those notes became a lot more valuable, and accounting rules require the company to record this change in value as an "expense."

In addition, there was an additional $8.8 billion charge listed as "other expense." This is another non-cash charge tied to Anthropic's financing. Between these two charges, that's more than an $81 billion accounting "charge" that didn't actually cost Anthropic any money at all.

How much Anthropic is really earning

As mentioned, Anthropic reported a $693 million operating loss for the first half, but when adjusting for certain non-cash items, the company had a $1.6 billion operating profit. This is an operating margin of nearly 10%, and from a company that grew second-quarter revenue by 1,368% year-over-year.

Story Continues

There's a good case to be made that Anthropic's profits could rise significantly in the near future. Its computing costs as a percentage of revenue have fallen dramatically over the past year, and newer models (like Claude Opus 5.5) are far cheaper to use than their predecessors.

Of course, adjusted profitability metrics exclude certain non-cash costs that investors should consider. For example, Anthropic's stock-based compensation expense was $2.2 billion in the first half, and although this isn't a cash expense, it dilutes existing shareholders' ownership.

It's also worth noting that Anthropic's reported revenue can look larger than it is. Specifically, many customers buy Claude through the cloud platforms run by Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), and Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG), but Anthropic contracts with the customers directly and pays these companies a fee.

The bottom line

The key takeaway for investors is that Anthropic isn't losing anything close to $80 billion running its business. Rather, it's far closer to breakeven, even on a GAAP operating basis, than many investors might have thought, and these large convertible note charges should go away after the notes convert to stock after the IPO is finished. One thing we don't yet know is Anthropic's IPO valuation , but we now know this is a fast-growing business that is getting very close to profitability.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger

Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

Continue »

news.Title: Pre-Q1 Earnings: Is Sandisk Stock a Portfolio Must-Have?
news.Content:
Sandisk SNDK is set to report its first-quarter fiscal 2027 results on Oct. 29.

For the to-be-reported quarter, SNDK expects revenues between $10.3 billion and $10.8 billion, indicating sequential growth of approximately 15-20% from the fourth quarter's $8.97 billion. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenues is pegged at $10.58 billion, suggesting 358.2% growth from the figure reported in the year-ago quarter.

Sandisk expects non-GAAP earnings between $44 and $46 per share. The consensus mark for earnings is pegged at $46.23 per share, unchanged over the past 30 days. SNDK reported earnings of $1.22 per share in the year-ago quarter.

Consensus Estimate Trend

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

SNDK's earnings have surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in all the trailing four quarters, with the average being 380.92%.

Sandisk Corporation Price and EPS Surprise

Sandisk Corporation price-eps-surprise | Sandisk Corporation Quote

Let us see how things have shaped up for the upcoming announcement.

Key Factors to Note Ahead of SNDK's Q1 Results

Sandisk is expected to have benefited from robust demand for NAND flash memory, accelerating artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, improving product mix and higher average selling prices (ASPs) in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. Growing demand for enterprise solid-state drives (SSDs), particularly from hyperscalers and AI infrastructure providers, is likely to have supported revenues and profitability.

Sandisk's first-quarter fiscal 2027 performance is expected to have benefited significantly from continued improvements in NAND pricing. Strong demand for high-capacity storage solutions, driven by AI inference workloads and hyperscale data center investments, is supporting favorable industry supply-demand dynamics. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, approximately two-thirds of Sandisk's sequential revenue growth came from higher pricing, with the remaining one-third attributable to increased volumes. This pricing momentum is likely to have continued into the first quarter of fiscal 2027, benefiting revenues and gross margins.

The company's Datacenter business is expected to have remained a major growth engine in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. Increasing adoption of AI inference, agentic AI and data-intensive applications is driving demand for high-performance, high-capacity enterprise SSDs. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Datacenter revenues increased 103% sequentially to $2.98 billion. SNDK expanded shipments of its compute-focused triple-level cell enterprise SSDs across hyperscale and AI infrastructure customers. Moreover, the commencement of revenue shipments for its quad-level cell Stargate platform is expected to have strengthened its position in high-capacity AI data lake applications.

Sandisk's transition toward advanced BiCS8 NAND technology is expected to have supported first-quarter performance. BiCS8 incorporates innovative technologies, including CMOS directly bonded to Array (CBA) and hybrid wafer bonding, enabling higher density and better manufacturing efficiency. Increased adoption of BiCS8-based products, particularly in enterprise applications, is likely to have supported higher-value product shipments and a favorable revenue mix.

Meanwhile, SNDK's strong pricing environment and improving revenue mix are expected to have supported profitability in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. The company's first-quarter gross margin guidance of 83-85% suggests profitability is expected to have remained near historically elevated levels. However, increased investments in research and development, higher employee-related expenses and technology transitions are likely to have raised operating costs. SNDK expects non-GAAP operating expenses between $520 million and $540 million compared with $484 million in the preceding quarter.

Story Continues

Sandisk Shares Outperform Sector & Peers

Sandisk shares have jumped 447.1% year to date (YTD), outperforming the Zacks Computer and Technology sector's appreciation of 14.9%. The company has outperformed its storage peers, including Western Digital WDC, Seagate STX and Micron Technology MU, over the same time frame, shares of which have returned 122.9%, 148.1% and 225.4%, respectively.

SNDK Stock's Price Performance

Sandisk shares are trading at a premium, as suggested by a Value Score of C. In terms of the forward 12-month price-to-sales (P/S), Sandisk is trading at 3.47X, higher than the Zacks Computer-Storage Devices industry's 2.41X. However, SNDK shares are trading at a lower multiple compared with Micron's 3.56X, Western Digital's 6.23X and Seagate's 6.92X.

SNDK Stock's Valuation

Strong AI Demand to Aid SNDK's Prospects

The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure represents one of Sandisk's most significant long-term growth opportunities. AI inference and agentic AI applications require substantial storage capacity to support data generation, retrieval and processing. Unlike traditional computing workloads, AI applications increasingly require persistent, high-performance storage capable of supporting enormous data volumes with low latency. SNDK expects the global NAND market to exceed $300 billion in calendar 2026 and approach $500 billion in calendar 2027.

Sandisk's investments in next-generation BiCS NAND technologies are expected to strengthen its long-term competitive position. The company is advancing BiCS9 and BiCS10 technologies while developing subsequent generations to improve storage density, performance and manufacturing economics. SNDK's scaling strategy emphasizes architectural, lateral and logical innovations rather than relying solely on increasing the number of NAND layers. The company's joint development efforts with Kioxia also provide access to substantial research and development resources and advanced manufacturing expertise.

Conclusion

Sandisk's first-quarter fiscal 2027 performance is expected to have benefited from improving NAND pricing, strong Datacenter demand, an expanding enterprise SSD portfolio and favorable product mix. Continued BiCS8 adoption and increasing revenue visibility from multiyear customer agreements are also likely to have supported profitability.

Sandisk currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) and has a Growth Score of A, a favorable combination that offers a strong investment opportunity, per the Zacks Proprietary methodology. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here.

news.Title: Meta Platforms Stock Falls Despite Posting Strong Q3 Numbers. Should Investors Buy the Dip?
news.Content:
Last week, social media giant Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) reported its third-quarter earnings. It was yet another solid quarter of growth, as the business continues to find ways to get bigger and generate more revenue. It's also eyeing significant growth opportunities in artificial intelligence (AI) and launched its new personal AI agent, Muse, back in September.

Despite the seemingly exciting potential ahead and its robust numbers, the stock has been falling since its quarterly results came out. Could this be a great opportunity for investors to buy the tech stock ?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Meta's growth remains impressive, but investors may be concerned about high spending

For the three-month period ending Sept. 30, Meta's revenue totaled $64.6 billion, which was a year-over-year increase of 26%. On the bottom line, things were a bit messy due to the legal settlement it reached involving litigation related to social media and mental health issues. The company reported a $9.9 billion charge this past quarter as a result of the agreement, and without that, it says its operating income would have totaled $22.9 billion -- representing an increase of 12% from the previous year.

Overall, however, it was another solid quarter for the business. In addition, its guidance for the current quarter was also better than the $73.7 billion analysts were expecting. Meta forecasts between $73 billion and $76 billion in revenue for the period.

What may have spooked investors a bit, however, is that for the period, Meta's free cash flow was negative $2.1 billion, compared with positive $10.6 billion a year ago. The company's heavy AI spending has resulted in a significant reduction in free cash flow. Capex spending this past quarter totaled $34.9 billion, up significantly from $19.4 billion a year ago.

The stock is down around 20% from its high, but is it worth buying?

Meta is investing heavily in AI, and CEO Mark Zuckerberg says he is confident that the efforts are well worth it, stating, "Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong."

Investors, however, may be a bit unsure about that these days, as despite a seemingly modest valuation, the stock is down 15% in the past 12 months. Based on analyst projections, it's trading at a forward price-to-earnings multiple of just 18, which is lower than the S&P 500 average of 19.

Story Continues

The legal issues related to social media health and concerns about high AI spending suggest that the stock should trade at a slight discount, given the uncertainty and risks ahead. That's why, while it may look cheap these days, I'd still take a wait-and-see approach.

news.Title: Conagra and Campbell's Have Already Cut Their Dividends in 2026. Could General Mills Be Next?
news.Content:
Food companies have been struggling this year. Between inflation and the growing popularity of GLP-1 drugs, which are curbing appetites, companies such as Conagra and Campbell's haven't been doing particularly well. Both of those companies cut their dividend payments this year.

Top cereal maker General Mills (NYSE:GIS), however, has kept its dividend intact, at least for now. At 7.2%, it's one of the highest-yielding stocks in the S&P 500 . But is it really safe?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

The company's sales were down last quarter, as were earnings

General Mills last reported earnings on Sept. 23, and that's a good place to start when looking at the safety of its payout, to get an idea of how it's been doing of late. For the quarter, which ended on Aug. 30, the company's net sales were down 3%, but that was due to its U.S. yogurt divestiture, and its organic sales were flat. While that's not awful, it's not terribly exciting, either.

A year ago, the food company got a boost from a gain on divestitures, but even after adjusting for that, its per-share profit this past quarter was $0.75, down from $0.86 in the prior-year period. At its current quarterly dividend rate of $0.61, its payout ratio is around 81%, which is a bit high but perhaps not unsustainable.

Cash flow can sometimes be a better indicator of a company's ability to pay dividends, as non-cash items such as depreciation and amortization can weigh down the bottom line. In the trailing 12 months, General Mills' free cash flow totaled $1.6 billion, which is higher than the $1.3 billion the business has paid in dividends over that period. It suggests there is a buffer there, but, as with earnings, it isn't a huge one.

The dividend looks safe for now, but investors should watch it closely

For now, I don't see a glaring reason why General Mills may cut its dividend in the near future. It's facing some challenges, but with the stock already down 45% over the past five years, news of a dividend cut may only cause its valuation to sink even further.

At the same time, however, investors shouldn't feel too comfortable with the business, as anytime a company is experiencing a decline in earnings and it's struggling to generate growth, there are valid reasons to be concerned about its dividend, as it may only be a matter of time before things get to a point where it needs to be reduced.

Story Continues

Although General Mills' dividend may look attractive for its high yield, a safer option may be to choose other dividend stocks with stronger financials.

news.Title: SCI Stock Surges More Than 111% in 6 Months: Can the Momentum Continue?
news.Content:
SCI Engineered Materials, Inc. 's SCIA investors have been gaining from the stock over the past few months. Shares of the Columbus, OH-based global supplier and manufacturer of advanced materials for Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) thin-film applications surged 111.3% in the past six months against the industry's 11.2% decline. It has also outperformed the sector and the S&P 500's gains of 6.6% and 6.4%, respectively, in the same time frame.

Two major developments of SCIA in recent months include the installation of a Plasma Spheroidization System or PSS (in August) and the announcement of its promising second-quarter 2026 results (in July).

In the second quarter, SCI reported record revenues and strong earnings growth, supported by higher raw material input costs, favorable product mix and increased volume. Higher revenues boosted gross profit, operating income and net income. However, gross margin contracted due to elevated raw material costs and product mix.

Management highlighted improving demand, new customer additions and growing traction in key markets. SCIA also expanded its workforce and ordered manufacturing equipment to support future growth, while interest in its specialized services continued to increase.

SCIA's Six-Month Price Comparison

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Over the past six months, the stock's performance has remained strong, outperforming its peers like Marvell Technology, Inc. MRVL and Cirrus Logic, Inc. CRUS. Marvell Technology and Cirrus Logic's shares have gained 52.6% and lost 30.5%, respectively, in the same time frame.

Despite risks related to significant customer concentration, fluctuating raw material costs and tariff uncertainties, SCI's favorable share price movement reflects positive investor sentiment.

SCIA primarily serves the photonics industry, supplying advanced materials for PVD thin-film applications. Its target markets include aerospace, automotive, defense, glass, optical coatings and solar. SCI collaborates with end users and original equipment manufacturers to develop customized material solutions.

SCIA's Growth Opportunities

SCI's expanding order backlog reflects improving business activity and provides greater visibility into potential future revenues. The backlog increased both sequentially and year over year at the end of the second quarter, indicating a stronger pipeline of customer orders. This development could support production planning and help sustain business activity as pending orders are fulfilled. Continued execution of these orders remains important for maintaining growth momentum.

Story Continues

SCI's installation of a PSS in August expanded its advanced materials manufacturing capabilities. The equipment enables the production of high-purity spherical powders suitable for additive manufacturing, including those derived from high-value precious metals. These capabilities could create opportunities in aeronautical, defense and biomedical applications, where material quality and performance are critical. Planned targeted marketing initiatives may help SCIA establish a stronger presence in these specialized markets.

SCI's toll manufacturing business offers additional opportunities beyond conventional material sales. Its capabilities include diffusion bonding, indium bonding, powder processing and vacuum hot pressing, addressing customers' specialized production requirements. Revenue from toll manufacturing and related services improved in the previous fiscal year, alongside growing demand for engineering-related projects. These customized offerings could deepen customer relationships and support additional business opportunities.

SCI's Financial Strength

SCI's operating cash flow strengthened during the first half of the year, supported by improved profitability and higher customer deposits. Cash reserves and working capital also increased from the previous year-end, reinforcing its liquidity position. These resources provide flexibility to meet operational requirements, fund equipment investments and pursue growth initiatives. The availability of an undrawn credit facility further supports its financial flexibility without immediately increasing borrowing obligations.

SCIA's ongoing share repurchase program reflects its commitment to shareholder-focused capital allocation. The company continued purchasing common shares during the first half of the year, reducing its share count and supporting earnings per share. Continued repurchases, subject to management discretion and business requirements, could further benefit per-share financial metrics.

Challenges Ahead of SCIA

SCI relies heavily on a limited number of major customers, exposing revenues to potential order reductions, delays or cancellations. The absence of minimum purchase commitments further heightens uncertainty regarding future sales visibility and business stability. SCIA's gross margins remain vulnerable to elevated raw material costs and unfavorable product mix. Its ability to protect profitability depends partly on passing higher input costs to customers without adversely affecting demand or competitive positioning.

SCI Stock's Valuation

SCI's trailing 12-month EV/Sales of 1.2X is lower than the industry's average of 13.3X but is higher than its five-year median of 0.6X.

Marvell Technology and Cirrus Logic's trailing 12-month EV/Sales currently stand at 21.8X and 2.3X, respectively.

Our Final Take on SCIA

SCI's impressive stock rally reflects strengthening business fundamentals and expanding growth opportunities. Its improving order pipeline, broader manufacturing capabilities and healthy financial position provide a supportive backdrop for continued business growth. However, customer concentration and cost-related pressures remain important considerations that could influence future performance.

From a valuation perspective, SCIA appears relatively inexpensive compared with the broader industry, suggesting potential room for further appreciation. However, its premium to historical valuation levels indicates that investors are already assigning greater value to its improving business prospects. This raises expectations for future performance and leaves less room for operational disappointments.

Overall, SCIA's positive momentum could continue if the company sustains operational improvements and capitalizes on emerging opportunities. Existing shareholders may consider maintaining their positions, while prospective investors may consider waiting for a more attractive entry point, given the sharp rally and valuation premium relative to historical levels.

news.Title: Alphabet Is Set to Become an Even Bigger Anthropic Shareholder After the IPO
news.Content:
Anthropic, one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies , could eclipse SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) as the biggest IPO in history when it goes public this year. It's reportedly targeting a $2 trillion valuation, which would top SpaceX's $1.77 trillion debut.

A major beneficiary of that massive IPO will be Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL), which already owns an estimated 14% stake in Anthropic. Let's see why that stake could grow even larger after its public debut.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

When did Alphabet start investing in Anthropic?

Alphabet began investing in Anthropic in late 2022 and early 2023, acquiring a 10% equity stake in the company for about $300 million. That deal established Alphabet's Google Cloud as one of Anthropic's primary cloud infrastructure providers for training and deploying AI models.

In late 2023, Alphabet invested another $500 million in Anthropic and agreed to invest an additional $1.5 billion over time. This year, it expanded that partnership with multi-billion-dollar direct equity injections and additional infrastructure deals for using its custom Tensor TPUs.

How much bigger will Alphabet's stake get?

At $2 trillion, Alphabet's stake in Anthropic would be worth $280 billion. According to Anthropic's S-1 filing, Alphabet retains an exclusive option to purchase up to $10 billion in additional shares directly at its offering price alongside its IPO.

Alphabet has also set aside $20 billion in unused investment capacity and deferred milestone funding obligations for Anthropic. If Anthropic thrives after its market debut, Alphabet will likely inject more of that capital into the company and gradually increase its equity stake.

What does this mean for Alphabet's future?

Alphabet's post-IPO investments should increase its stake in Anthropic, but it will likely remain the company's second-largest shareholder after Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN). Amazon holds a 15%-20% stake in Anthropic, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) is another one of Anthropic's primary cloud infrastructure providers for training and deploying AI models.

By investing in Anthropic, Alphabet can keep pace with Amazon in the cloud infrastructure race. It also ensures that Anthropic's Claude -- a major competitor to Google's Gemini -- remains partly dependent on Google's cloud infrastructure and TPUs for the foreseeable future.

Story Continues

Anthropic's pre-IPO valuation is already baked into Alphabet's net income (at its last post-money valuation of $965 billion), but that value would more than double with a $2 trillion IPO. Therefore, Anthropic's IPO could generate strong near-term tailwinds for Alphabet, Amazon, and other companies that hold early stakes in the growing AI company.

news.Title: Sandisk Stock Has Been Cut Nearly in Half Since June. Should You Buy It Before Thursday's Report?
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) stock hit its highest close ever on June 25, ending the day at $2,335. Four months later, the flash memory maker's shares trade near $1,262 as I write -- about 46% lower.

And the slide hasn't eased lately. The growth stock has lost about another 10% since Oct. 15, including a drop of over 8% on Oct. 22, when the PHLX Semiconductor Index fell nearly 7%.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That leaves the stock near where it closed the day after Sandisk's last quarterly report, in early August. The next report comes Thursday, Oct. 29.

Is the slide a chance to buy before then? I think it rests on three things the quarter has to show: rising flash prices, tight supply, and growing data center sales.

Image source: Getty Images.

Prices are still rising, just more slowly

Sandisk's guidance for its fiscal first quarter of 2027, which ended in early October, puts revenue at $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion. The midpoint is around 18% above the $8.97 billion Sandisk took in during fiscal Q4. Sequential growth was 97% in fiscal Q3 and 51% in fiscal Q4, so the guidance suggests a second straight quarter of slowing growth.

Management expects both more storage shipped and what chief financial officer Luis Visoso called "modest price increases" to fuel this growth. On the August earnings call, he said that Sandisk had already raised prices significantly in the quarter before.

This timing matters when comparing Sandisk to Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU), which also sells NAND flash. Micron said its NAND prices rose around 30% sequentially in its fiscal fourth quarter, which ended Sept. 3 and covered two of the three months in Sandisk's quarter.

Still, if flash prices kept climbing at anywhere near Micron's rate, Thursday's report might show pricing adding more than the guidance assumed.

But the fiscal second-quarter outlook may matter even more. An outlook that counts on volume alone might signal Sandisk's price hikes are petering out.

Sandisk says demand is outpacing supply

Supply matters just as much, since tight supply is what lets prices climb. Sandisk expects its sellable bits (the storage capacity it has available to sell) to grow by a mid-teens percentage in fiscal 2027. That's a little under its normal target, because Sandisk plans to carry more inventory to support its multiyear supply deals. Plus, Visoso said customer demand is rising faster than supply, so Sandisk expects its output to stay on allocation (rationed among customers) beyond calendar 2027. And Micron, too, expects the NAND industry to remain supply-constrained in both 2027 and 2028.

Story Continues

Much of this demand is from data centers. Showing how fast the business has changed, Sandisk's data center revenue more than tripled from $440 million in fiscal Q2 2026 to $1.47 billion in fiscal Q3, then more than doubled to $2.98 billion in fiscal Q4. By then it was one-third of total revenue. For fiscal 2026, data center revenue climbed 437%.

Sandisk doesn't guide by end market, so Thursday's report will be the first look at how that business held up in fiscal Q1. Micron's results are encouraging here, too. Its data center SSD revenue was almost $10 billion for its fiscal Q4, up over tenfold from the year-ago quarter.

Should you buy before Thursday?

The stock price seems to assume the boom ends soon. At roughly $1,262, Sandisk's price-to-earnings ratio is about 18, based on the $70.88 in non-GAAP (adjusted) earnings per share it made in fiscal 2026.

Using analysts' consensus estimate of adjusted earnings in fiscal 2027, which ends in mid-2027, the forward price-to-earnings ratio drops to about 6. Micron's is about 5 on its own fiscal 2027 consensus. At price-to-earnings ratios that low, investors seem to expect memory profits to shrink soon.

Six times earnings is arguably a cheap valuation for a business that expects its output to stay rationed past 2027. That said, one outlook has already moved the stock hard. Shares dropped almost 7% the day after the August report, when management guided for just modest price increases.

So, should you buy Sandisk before Thursday's report?

I'd wait for it, even though the stock looks more appealing than it did two weeks ago. But the fiscal Q2 outlook should show if Sandisk is still raising prices, and I'd rather see that before buying a stock this volatile.

news.Title: Equities Bounce: 3 Top Ranked Stocks to Buy Now (TER, LRCX, ATI)
news.Content:
After a sharp bout of volatility, the stock market appears to be finding its footing ahead of a busy week of corporate earnings, central bank meetings and critical economic data.

While these selloffs can be painful, it is worth remembering just how consistently the market manages to climb the proverbial wall of worry. Whether it's concerns over AI, tariffs, elections or geopolitical tensions, the resilience of the US stock market has been remarkable.

And while it can be tempting to follow every headline and attempt to anticipate every possible scenario, investors are often better served by tuning out the noise and focusing on what matters most: buying high-quality companies at attractive valuations, particularly when earnings expectations are moving higher.

That combination of strong fundamentals, reasonable valuations and positive earnings revisions has historically been a powerful formula for long-term investment success.

With that in mind, three stocks currently stand out to me as particularly compelling opportunities. Teradyne (TER), Lam Research (LRCX) and ATI INC (ATI) are established industry leaders with impressive long-term track records, favorable earnings revision trends and exposure to powerful secular growth opportunities.

All three have delivered tremendous returns over the years, but recent market volatility has created potentially attractive entry points for investors looking to capitalize on the next leg higher.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Teradyne Stock: Exceptional Growth at a Fair Price

Teradyne is a leading provider of automated test equipment used to verify the performance and reliability of semiconductors, along with advanced robotics systems for industrial automation. The company is a major beneficiary of the AI infrastructure boom, as increasingly sophisticated chips and memory components require more extensive testing.

The growth outlook is exceptional. Analysts expect sales to surge 58.9% this year, followed by another 20.9% increase next year. Meanwhile, earnings are projected to grow at an annualized rate of 54.4% over the next three to five years.

Despite that tremendous growth outlook, Teradyne trades at 33.9x forward earnings, giving it a remarkably attractive PEG ratio of just 0.62 . That suggests investors are paying a relatively modest premium for the company's anticipated earnings growth.

With a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) , Teradyne offers a compelling combination of powerful secular tailwinds, explosive earnings growth and a valuation that looks increasingly reasonable following the recent pullback.

Story Continues

Lam Research Stock: A Semiconductor Powerhouse

Lam Research is one of the world's leading suppliers of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, specializing in the technologies used to deposit, etch and clean materials on silicon wafers. Its equipment is essential to producing advanced logic chips and memory, making Lam a critical supplier to the ongoing AI infrastructure expansion.

The company is particularly well positioned to benefit from the memory supercycle, as demand for high-bandwidth memory and increasingly complex chip architectures drives greater investment in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

Analysts expect sales to grow 49.7% this year and another 19% next year, while earnings are projected to compound at an annualized rate of 28.2% over the next three to five years.

Even with that impressive growth profile, Lam trades at just 24.8x forward earnings , giving it a PEG ratio of 0.88. For a company with such an entrenched competitive position and exposure to one of the market's strongest investment themes, that valuation looks attractive.

Lam currently carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) , reinforcing its favorable earnings outlook and making it another compelling opportunity for long-term investors.

ATI Stock: Aerospace Growth at a Compelling Valuation

ATI INC is a leading producer of high-performance specialty materials, including titanium alloys, nickel-based superalloys and advanced components used in aerospace, defense and other demanding industrial applications.

The company occupies an attractive position in the aerospace supply chain, providing critical materials used in jet engines, aircraft structures and defense systems. Rising commercial aircraft production, growing defense spending and demand for next-generation engines create a long runway for growth.

ATI's earnings outlook is particularly impressive, with analysts forecasting annualized EPS growth of 32.8% over the next three to five years.

Shares currently trade at 32.1x forward earnings, giving the stock a PEG ratio just below 1.0 . While that earnings multiple might initially appear elevated for an industrial company, the anticipated growth rate makes the valuation considerably more attractive.

ATI also carries a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) , reflecting positive earnings estimate revisions and strengthening expectations for the business.

Should Investors Buy Shares in LRCX, ATI and TER?

Market volatility can be unsettling, but it also creates opportunities to buy exceptional businesses at more attractive prices.

Teradyne, Lam Research and ATI operate in different corners of the economy, yet all three share several important characteristics: strong competitive positions, exposure to durable secular growth trends and impressive long-term earnings prospects.

More importantly, their valuations appear reasonable relative to their projected earnings growth, with all three sporting PEG ratios below 1.0.

Of course, none is immune to a broader market correction, and those ambitious growth forecasts will need to be met. But with favorable Zacks Ranks, powerful industry tailwinds and compelling growth-adjusted valuations, TER, LRCX and ATI deserve serious consideration from investors looking to take advantage of the recent market volatility.

台股近期呈現強烈多空交戰，但內資力挺力道極為強勁。檢視籌碼面，投信單日狂買超236.45億元，一舉呈現連續11個交易日買超，累計買超金額高達1,799.69億元。葉育碩剖析，投信這股龐大的資金源頭，很大一部分來自於國人踴躍申購台股ETF，背後代表一群台灣人持續透過定期定額或大筆申購，將資金交給基金經理人進行專業配置。散戶單打獨鬥是一股力量，但眾人團結累積起來的資金規模更是驚人，讓葉育碩不禁驚嘆 「咱們第四法人是真的很有錢」 ，成為抗衡外資賣壓的關鍵基石。
